name: Counters
description: Count anything on your server. Name each counter, and members add to it with a button. ShifuBot shows the top 20 on Discord and the full list on a page for members.

defaults.name: New counter
defaults.title: {name}
defaults.description: Press the button and your count goes up by one. Pressed it by accident? **Undo** takes it back for a few minutes.

panel.empty: Nothing counted yet. Be the first!
panel.failed: Settings saved, but the panel could not be updated: {error}
panel.help: Use this if someone deleted the panel message.

overview.limitReached: This server has reached its limit of {limit} counters. Delete one to make a new one.
overview.emptyBody: Make your first counter, for example for push-ups, coffee or anything else your server wants to count.

form.identityHelp: What this counter counts. Members see these on Discord and on the full list.
form.name: Name
form.unitHelp: The word after the number, for example "push-ups". Leave empty for the default.
form.emojiHelp: One emoji. It appears in the title, on the button and next to the total.
form.enabledHelp: ShifuBot posts a panel with the buttons in the channel below.
form.cooldownHelp: Minutes a member must wait between two presses. 0 turns it off.
form.undoWindowHelp: For this many minutes a member can take back a press. Only their own presses, and only as many as they made.
form.showLeaderboard: Show the top 20 and the total
form.showLeaderboardHelp: The panel is updated at most every 15 seconds. The Full list button is always there.
form.title: Title
form.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default text in the server language.

status.noChannel: Pick a channel for the panel.
status.channelMissing: The selected channel no longer exists. Choose another one.
status.missingPermissions: ShifuBot is missing permissions in this channel: {permissions}.
status.panelMissing: The panel is not posted yet. Save, or post it again below.

top.title: Top 20
top.openListHelp: Every member of the server can open it after signing in with Discord.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: The panel exactly as Discord will show it, with the current numbers.

list.notOnList: You are not on this list yet. Press the button on the panel in Discord to get on it.
list.empty: Nothing counted yet. Be the first!

delete.help: Removes the panel from Discord and every count of this counter. This cannot be undone.
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: The panel message and all counts of this counter will be gone for good.

replies.counted: Counted! You are at **{count}** {unit}. Pressed it by accident? **Undo** works until {time}.
replies.cooldown: Easy there. You can count the next one {time}.
replies.undone: Taken back. You are at **{count}** {unit} now.
replies.nothingToUndo: Nothing to undo. Only presses from the last {minutes} minutes can be taken back.

errors.missing_permissions: missing permissions in the panel channel
errors.limit_reached: this server has reached its counter limit
